answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a DC-DC converter module for converting 54 VDC to 12 VDC with high power output. FPM-DCDC modules are designed for board-level DC-DC conversion, supporting up to 1.5 kW output power, which matches the requirement.

The requirement specifies telemetry over PMBus and high efficiency for the DC-DC converter. FPM-DCDC modules include PMBus communication and achieve high efficiency, typically around 97%, meeting the requirement.

The requirement specifies compact dimensions for the DC-DC converter. FPM-DCDC modules are available in compact formats suitable for board-level integration, which aligns with the specified dimensions.
